answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes: each agent locks twice its 30-day expected reward, released over 20 epochs only as a fingerprint forms from varied timing, tools, and partners. Making 100 fakes costs 100 deposits plus 100 histories for one vote each, while one honest agent pays once, unlocks, and keeps undiluted rewards.
